description: Initialize and migrate death/offscreen history and let Mara answer the deliberately unexplained cutaway

replacements.old:
;"Release 1244 saves retain every witnessed House and Dam event."
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-RESTRAINT-ATTEMPTED 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-COMBAT-ORDER-ATTEMPTED 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-BOUND-TROLL-WITNESSED 0>)
replacements.new:
;"Release 1245 saves retain all existing Mara history. Only the
             newly introduced death-witness and offscreen-comedy fields begin empty."
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-DEATH-WITNESSED 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-OFFSCREEN-GAG 0>)

<COND (<EQUAL? .TOPIC ,MARA-UNEXPLAINED-TOPIC>
           <COND (<ZERO? <MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-OFFSCREEN-GAG>>
                  <TELL "Mara looks genuinely puzzled. Nothing happened, she says." CR>)
                 (<EQUAL? <MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-OFFSCREEN-GAG> 1>
                  <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-OFFSCREEN-GAG 2>
                  <TELL "No, Mara says." CR>)
                 (T
                  <TELL "Absolutely not, Mara says." CR>)>)
          (<EQUAL? .TOPIC ,MARA-SURVEY-TOPIC ,MAP>
